knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says never to infer microbial safety from appearance alone and to judge against stated acceptance criteria.
Inaccessible areas are marked as not inspected rather than passed. Entry without permission is not allowed.
The set inspection boundaries section says to confirm access permission and any hazards before entering.

practicalCriteria: Learner completes procedure step 1: Obtain the signed scope, site map, inspection checklist and acceptance standards before starting.
Learner completes procedure step 2: Separate contractual inclusions from optional requests, and confirm access permission and any hazards before entering.
Learner completes procedure step 3: List the rooms, surfaces and high-touch points, and agree which critical items are inspected first.
Learner completes procedure step 4: Walk a consistent clockwise or zone-based route, and note which items need direct observation and which need documentary evidence.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 1: Obtain the signed scope, site map, inspection checklist and acceptance standards before starting.
Record of procedure step 4: Walk a consistent clockwise or zone-based route, and note which items need direct observation and which need documentary evidence.
Record of procedure step 5: Record any area that cannot be reached as not inspected, never as passed.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 2 is not done: Separate contractual inclusions from optional requests, and confirm access permission and any hazards before entering.
Stop work if procedure step 5 is not done: Record any area that cannot be reached as not inspected, never as passed.

Stop work if procedure step 7 is not done: Report sharps, suspected biological contamination, chemical exposure, damaged electrical equipment or unsafe access to the responsible person, and do not start remediation yourself.
